parameters.name: NeedResourceInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether you want the resource information to be returned.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags that you want to attach to the instance. You can attach up to 20 tags to the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-instance-in-service-list --tag Value=SericeA Key=CartService --need-resource-info true --region cn-hangzhou
